place: wet cobbled street under a theatre marquee, night
shows: All six robbers in long overcoats stroll straight at the lens in a line, slow and cocky, marquee bulbs glowing behind them. Nobody runs; it is a swagger walk.
faults: triangles too small to read on most masks; they barely advance despite walking

place: wooden speedboat on black water, searchlight
shows: PLUM (plum mask, mustard suit) stands one foot up in the stern of a racing speedboat, pointing ahead, crates of bottles on deck, spray flying.
faults: crates and bottles fly loose in the first second then settle; boat jumps position between beats (looping wake)

place: steam train on a timber trestle, golden hour
shows: Wide side view: two robbers with cash sacks sprint along the carriage roofs as the train crosses a trestle; hats tumble away in the wind.
faults: men too small to read masks; they run on the spot; far more hats flying than two men could lose

place: busy theatre street at dusk, cream roadster
shows: A robber in an oxblood suit stands in an open cream roadster flinging banknotes from a sack over a cheering crowd; a gold-masked driver sits at the wheel.
faults: standing man wears a dark crimson mask with the oxblood suit (should be silver-grey); car barely moves

place: basement speakeasy distillery with GIN crates and a copper still
shows: High angle: five robbers stand in a ring under a swinging bulb pointing finger-guns, one holding a banana, all deadpan.
faults: the thumb-drop barely reads; otherwise none seen

place: grand bank hall with brass teller cages
shows: CRIMSON (crimson mask, grey fedora, dark suit) braced wide fires a drum-mag tommy gun at the globe lamps, which burst in glass and sparks.
faults: suit reads plain black rather than pinstripe; shot lamps reappear whole in later frames

place: steel girder high over a 1920s city
shows: All six sit along a skyscraper beam like the famous lunch photo, legs dangling, counting notes; CRIMSON passes a sandwich with a banknote along the row.
faults: the hand-off reaches across the cream-suit man to the wrong neighbour; triangles hard to read

place: stern of a speedboat at sea, daylight
shows: CRIMSON (fedora, pinstripe) and a dark-masked man in black stand at the stern behind a crate of banknotes; notes spill onto the deck and the hatted man looks at a single note.
faults: notes pile onto the deck instead of going over the side, the crate empties and refills; right man has a dark navy mask with a black suit (mismatch)

place: elevated train curve over a city street, daylight
shows: CRIMSON (fedora, pinstripe, white tie) hangs off a train's outside step with a cash bag swinging over the drop, while a commuter in the window reads his paper and hands him a ticket.

place: skyscraper mooring mast with a blimp, dusk
shows: MARINE (navy mask, cream suit) slides down a rope from a moored blimp while the other five stand at the parapet watching.
faults: rope man bobs up and down instead of descending smoothly

place: bank vault doorway with a clerk at his desk
shows: A visored clerk at a desk turns and slowly raises his hands; behind him in the round vault doorway PLUM and CRIMSON stand posed with upright tommy guns.

place: steel vault corridor strung with bell threads
shows: MARINE (navy mask, cream suit) limbos backwards under alarm threads while BOTTLE (green mask, brown tweed) strolls forward through them.
faults: tweed man passes through taut threads without tripping bells; limber man's pose flips and wobbles
